_doc: Unique characters (docs/CONTENT.md section 16): named crew with an active ability. Empty for now; packs add them (data/packs/<pack>/characters.json, same shape). Per character: id (snake_case), name, and exactly one of `species` (an id of data/species.json) or `unique_species` (a one-of-a-kind species of their own, shaped like a species entry: name, hp, speed, traits (ids of the trait library), rig (an art/crew folder), sidearm, and trait keys inline; it is known as `unique:<id>`). `rig` (optional): the look over the species' art: {tint: a #rrggbb outfit colour, head: the name of a head frame of the rig's art/crew/<rig>/crew.json}. `traits`: personal traits, either a list of ids of the trait library or an object of trait keys (data/traits.json `_doc`), merged with the species'. `ability`: {id (data/crew_abilities.json), cooldown?, params?}. `obtained`: how you get them (text for the codex). `lore`: a line or two. The campaign's recruit effect names one: {"character": "<id>"}. Rules: scripts/crew/characters.gd, checked by tests/test_crew_abilities.gd and tests/test_content.gd.
